changelog: **Database observability (#1608):** one Prisma timing middleware (`src/lib/prisma.ts`, registered first, one-time guarded) feeds `observeQuery(model, action, durationMs)` in `src/lib/dbQueryObserver.ts` — never the query's values. Slow operations log a warning with model, action, duration and the request id behind `DB_SLOW_QUERY_MS` (off in production until measured, 200 ms elsewhere). Every query inside a `withRequestScope` request is counted; past `DB_QUERY_WARN_CEILING` (default 50) one warning names the top models, and outside production the count is returned as `x-db-queries`. A reporting-only N+1 spec (`e2e/db-query-report.spec.ts`) records per-model query counts for `/messages`, `/admin/board` and `/admin/candidates` from a test-only tally (`DB_QUERY_TALLY=1`, `/api/dev/db-tally`, 404 elsewhere, ADMIN-only). New composite indexes: `EmailLog [status, createdAt]` (defuses the documented `/api/health` landmine), `ActivityLog [orgId, createdAt]`, `Message [senderId, createdAt]`. Docs: `docs/observability.md`; `docs/testing.md` updated.
